mapper.select: SELECT C.CAFETERIA_ID, C.MEAL_DATE, C.MEAL_TYPE, C.MENU, C.MEAL_CLOSED, FROM CAFETERIA C INNER JOIN ( SELECT MAX(CAFETERIA_ID) AS max_id FROM CAFETERIA GROUP BY MEAL_DATE, MEAL_TYPE )latest ON C.CAFETERIA_ID = latest.max_id WHERE YEAR(C.MEAL_DATE) = #{mealYear} AND MONTH(C.MEAL_DATE) = #{mealMonth} GROUP BY C.MEAL_DATE ORDER BY C.MEAL_DATE ASC

SELECT C.CAFETERIA_ID, C.MEAL_DATE, C.MEAL_TYPE, C.MENU, C.MEAL_CLOSED FROM CAFETERIA C INNER JOIN ( SELECT MAX(CAFETERIA_ID) AS max_id FROM CAFETERIA GROUP BY MEAL_DATE, MEAL_TYPE ) latest ON C.CAFETERIA_ID = latest.max_id WHERE C.MEAL_DATE = #{mealDate} AND C.DEL_YN = 'N'
